conversations.title: At the Rental Desk
conversations.description: Start your car rental process at the counter.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Come posso aiutarla oggi?
messages.english: Good morning! How can I help you today?

choices.text: Buongiorno, vorrei noleggiare un'auto per tre giorni.
choices.english: Good morning, I would like to rent a car for three days.
choices.feedback: Perfect start. Clear and polite.

choices.text: Voglio una pizza margherita e un'acqua.
choices.english: I want a margherita pizza and a water.
choices.feedback: Wrong place! You are at a car rental desk.

choices.text: Dove sono le chiavi della mia camera?
choices.english: Where are the keys to my room?
choices.feedback: That's for a hotel, not a car rental.

messages.text: Certamente. Ha già una prenotazione o vuole vedere le tariffe?
messages.english: Certainly. Do you already have a reservation or do you want to see the rates?

choices.text: Ho una prenotazione a nome Rossi. Ecco il codice.
choices.english: I have a reservation under the name Rossi. Here is the code.
choices.feedback: Good job providing the reservation details.

choices.text: Sì, vorrei un tavolo per due persone per favore.
choices.english: Yes, I would like a table for two people please.
choices.feedback: Still thinking about restaurants? Focus on the car!

choices.text: No, non ho la patente di guida con me.
choices.english: No, I don't have my driver's license with me.
choices.feedback: You need a license to rent a car!

messages.text: Ottimo, vedo la sua prenotazione. Posso avere la sua patente e un documento?
messages.english: Great, I see your reservation. Can I have your license and an ID?

choices.text: Certamente, ecco la mia patente e la mia carta d'identità.
choices.english: Certainly, here is my license and my ID card.
choices.feedback: Correct documents provided.

choices.text: Non ho documenti, ma ho molti soldi.
choices.english: I don't have documents, but I have a lot of money.
choices.feedback: Money is not enough; you need documents.

choices.text: Il mio passaporto è in aeroporto, mi dispiace.
choices.english: My passport is at the airport, I'm sorry.
choices.feedback: You must have your ID to rent a car.

messages.text: Grazie. Tutto in regola. La patente è valida per l'Italia.
messages.english: Thank you. Everything is in order. The license is valid for Italy.

choices.text: Molto bene. Qual è il costo totale del noleggio?
choices.english: Very well. What is the total cost of the rental?
choices.feedback: Asking about the price is a logical next step.

choices.text: Bene. Posso fumare dentro la macchina?
choices.english: Good. Can I smoke inside the car?
choices.feedback: Most rentals are non-smoking. Better to ask about costs first.

choices.text: Grazie. A che ora è la colazione domani?
choices.english: Thank you. What time is breakfast tomorrow?
choices.feedback: Again, this is not a hotel!

messages.text: Il totale è di centocinquanta euro, inclusi chilometri illimitati.
messages.english: The total is one hundred and fifty euros, including unlimited kilometers.

choices.text: Va bene, il prezzo mi sembra giusto. Grazie.
choices.english: Okay, the price seems fair to me. Thank you.
choices.feedback: Accepting the rate politely.

choices.text: È troppo caro! Voglio uno sconto del cinquanta per cento.
choices.english: It's too expensive! I want a fifty percent discount.
choices.feedback: A bit aggressive for a standard rental.

choices.text: Posso pagare con dei cornetti caldi?
choices.english: Can I pay with some hot croissants?
choices.feedback: Humorous, but they only accept money or cards.

messages.text: Ottimo. Preferisce pagare con carta di credito o bancomat?
messages.english: Great. Do you prefer to pay by credit card or debit card?

choices.text: Pago con la mia carta di credito, per favore.
choices.english: I'll pay with my credit card, please.
choices.feedback: Credit card is standard for rentals.

choices.text: Voglio pagare con una vecchia moneta d'oro.
choices.english: I want to pay with an old gold coin.
choices.feedback: They only accept modern payment methods.

choices.text: Posso pagare domani quando torno?
choices.english: Can I pay tomorrow when I return?
choices.feedback: You must pay or provide a card at the start.

messages.text: Va bene. Devo chiederle anche un deposito cauzionale.
messages.english: Alright. I also need to ask you for a security deposit.

choices.text: Nessun problema. A quanto ammonta il deposito?
choices.english: No problem. How much is the deposit?
choices.feedback: Asking for the amount is correct.

choices.text: Non voglio dare niente, non mi fido di voi.
choices.english: I don't want to give anything, I don't trust you.
choices.feedback: A deposit is mandatory for car rentals.

choices.text: Posso lasciare il mio gatto come deposito?
choices.english: Can I leave my cat as a deposit?
choices.feedback: Only money or card holds are accepted.

messages.text: Sono trecento euro. Verranno sbloccati alla fine del noleggio.
messages.english: It's three hundred euros. They will be unlocked at the end of the rental.

choices.text: D'accordo. Ecco la mia carta per il deposito.
choices.english: Agreed. Here is my card for the deposit.
choices.feedback: Providing the card for the hold.

choices.text: È troppo! Non ho tutti questi soldi sulla carta.
choices.english: It's too much! I don't have all this money on the card.
choices.feedback: You need enough credit for the deposit.

choices.text: Va bene, ma voglio gli interessi sul deposito.
choices.english: Okay, but I want interest on the deposit.
choices.feedback: Rental companies don't pay interest on deposits.

messages.text: Perfetto. Può inserire la carta nel lettore e digitare il PIN?
messages.english: Perfect. Can you insert the card in the reader and type the PIN?

choices.text: Sì, faccio subito. Ecco fatto, operazione eseguita.
choices.english: Yes, I'll do it right away. There, transaction done.
choices.feedback: Completing the payment process.

choices.text: No, il PIN è un segreto che non dirò mai.
choices.english: No, the PIN is a secret I will never tell.
choices.feedback: You must enter your PIN to pay.

choices.text: La macchina mangia la mia carta, aiuto!
choices.english: The machine is eating my card, help!
choices.feedback: Just insert it gently into the reader.

messages.text: Grazie. Ecco lo scontrino. Ora andiamo a vedere l'auto.
messages.english: Thank you. Here is the receipt. Now let's go see the car.

choices.text: Ottimo, andiamo subito. Sono pronto per guidare.
choices.english: Great, let's go right away. I am ready to drive.
choices.feedback: Ready for the next step.

choices.text: No, preferisco restare qui a leggere il contratto.
choices.english: No, I prefer to stay here and read the contract.
choices.feedback: You can read it later; let's see the car first.

choices.text: Voglio un'altra macchina, questa non mi piace.
choices.english: I want another car, I don't like this one.
choices.feedback: You haven't even seen it yet!

conversations.title: Choosing a Car
conversations.description: Select the vehicle that best suits your needs.

messages.text: Abbiamo diversi modelli disponibili. Preferisce un'auto piccola o un SUV?
messages.english: We have several models available. Do you prefer a small car or an SUV?

choices.text: Preferisco un'auto piccola, è più facile da parcheggiare.
choices.english: I prefer a small car, it's easier to park.
choices.feedback: Smart choice for Italian cities.

choices.text: Voglio un autobus per venti persone.
choices.english: I want a bus for twenty people.
choices.feedback: They usually only rent cars and SUVs here.

choices.text: Non mi piace guidare, preferisco camminare.
choices.english: Then why are you at a car rental?
choices.feedback: Then why are you at a car rental?

messages.text: Ottima scelta. Abbiamo una Fiat 500. Vuole il cambio manuale o automatico?
messages.english: Great choice. We have a Fiat 500. Do you want manual or automatic transmission?

choices.text: Vorrei il cambio automatico, se possibile.
choices.english: I would like automatic transmission, if possible.
choices.feedback: Good. Automatic is common for tourists.

choices.text: Il cambio non serve, vado sempre dritto.
choices.english: The gear shift isn't needed, I always go straight.
choices.feedback: That's not how cars work!

choices.text: Preferisco una bicicletta con il cestino.
choices.english: I prefer a bicycle with a basket.
choices.feedback: Wrong vehicle type.

messages.text: Sì, abbiamo una versione automatica. Quante porte desidera?
messages.english: Yes, we have an automatic version. How many doors do you want?

choices.text: Una macchina con cinque porte è più comoda per i bagagli.
choices.english: A car with five doors is more convenient for luggage.
choices.feedback: Correct logic for a trip.

choices.text: Voglio una macchina senza porte, come una jeep.
choices.english: I want a car without doors, like a jeep.
choices.feedback: Not available for this model.

choices.text: Non lo so, non so contare fino a cinque.
choices.english: I don't know, I don't know how to count to five.
choices.feedback: Basic numbers are important!

messages.text: Perfetto. La macchina è grigia. Ha bisogno del navigatore GPS?
messages.english: Perfect. The car is gray. Do you need a GPS navigator?

choices.text: Sì, il navigatore è molto utile per me. Grazie.
choices.english: Yes, the navigator is very useful for me. Thank you.
choices.feedback: Helpful for navigating new roads.

choices.text: No, uso le stelle per trovare la strada.
choices.english: No, I use the stars to find my way.
choices.feedback: Romantic, but GPS is safer.

choices.text: Preferisco usare una vecchia mappa di carta rotta.
choices.english: I prefer to use a broken old paper map.
choices.feedback: GPS is much easier.

messages.text: Benissimo. Aggiungiamo il GPS al contratto. Altro?
messages.english: Very well. We'll add the GPS to the contract. Anything else?

choices.text: No, per ora va bene così. Grazie mille.
choices.english: No, that's fine for now. Thanks a lot.
choices.feedback: Politely finishing the selection.

choices.text: Sì, voglio anche un autista privato.
choices.english: Yes, I also want a private driver.
choices.feedback: This is a self-drive rental.

choices.text: Voglio un gelato al cioccolato ora.
choices.english: I want a chocolate gelato now.
choices.feedback: They don't sell gelato here!

messages.text: Desidera anche un seggiolino per bambini o delle catene?
messages.english: Do you also want a child seat or chains?

choices.text: No, non ho bisogno di questi accessori. Grazie.
choices.english: No, I don't need these accessories. Thank you.
choices.feedback: Declining extras clearly.

choices.text: Sì, voglio un seggiolino per il mio cane.
choices.english: Yes, I want a seat for my dog.
choices.feedback: Usually these are for human children.

choices.text: Voglio delle catene d'oro per la macchina.
choices.english: I want gold chains for the car.
choices.feedback: Snow chains are for safety, not jewelry!

messages.text: Abbiamo anche l'opzione per un secondo conducente.
messages.english: We also have an option for a second driver.

choices.text: No, guido solo io per tutto il tempo.
choices.english: No, only I will drive the whole time.
choices.feedback: Staying with one driver.

choices.text: Sì, voglio aggiungere il mio amico invisibile.
choices.english: Yes, I want to add my invisible friend.
choices.feedback: The driver must have a valid license.

choices.text: Posso far guidare un bambino di dieci anni?
choices.english: Can I let a ten-year-old child drive?
choices.feedback: Absolutely not! Drivers must be adults.

messages.text: D'accordo. Ricordi che l'auto è a benzina, non diesel.
messages.english: Agreed. Remember that the car is gasoline, not diesel.

choices.text: Grazie del consiglio. Starò attento al distributore.
choices.english: Thanks for the advice. I'll be careful at the pump.
choices.feedback: Important to use the right fuel.

choices.text: Metterò dell'acqua minerale nel serbatoio.
choices.english: I'll put some mineral water in the tank.
choices.feedback: That would destroy the engine!

choices.text: Il diesel ha un sapore migliore per l'auto?
choices.english: Does diesel taste better for the car?
choices.feedback: Cars don't taste; they need specific fuel.

messages.text: L'auto si trova al parcheggio P3, settore B. Ecco le chiavi.
messages.english: The car is at parking lot P3, sector B. Here are the keys.

choices.text: Perfetto, vado subito a cercarla. Grazie di tutto.
choices.english: Perfect, I'm going to look for it right away. Thanks for everything.
choices.feedback: Ready to pick up the vehicle.

choices.text: Il parcheggio è troppo lontano, voglio volare.
choices.english: The parking is too far, I want to fly.
choices.feedback: It's just a short walk away.

choices.text: Ho paura del colore grigio, posso averla rossa?
choices.english: I'm afraid of the color gray, can I have it red?
choices.feedback: Gray is the only one available now.

messages.text: Buon viaggio! La macchina è proprio là fuori.
messages.english: Have a good trip! The car is right out there.

choices.text: Grazie mille e arrivederci! A presto.
choices.english: Thanks a lot and goodbye! See you soon.
choices.feedback: Friendly departure.

choices.text: Non voglio andare via, mi piace l'ufficio.
choices.english: I don't want to leave, I like the office.
choices.feedback: The car is waiting for you!

choices.text: Dov'è l'aeroporto? Mi sono già perso.
choices.english: Where is the airport? I'm already lost.
choices.feedback: Use the GPS we just added!

conversations.title: Insurance & Safety
conversations.description: Discuss coverage options and safety rules.

messages.text: Parliamo dell'assicurazione. Vuole la copertura totale per i danni?
messages.english: Let's talk about insurance. Do you want full coverage for damages?

choices.text: Sì, preferisco la copertura totale per essere sicuro.
choices.english: Yes, I prefer full coverage to be safe.
choices.feedback: Wise choice for peace of mind.

choices.text: No, non credo negli incidenti.
choices.english: No, I don't believe in accidents.
choices.feedback: Accidents happen regardless of belief.

choices.text: L'assicurazione è per i deboli.
choices.english: Insurance is for the weak.
choices.feedback: That's not a very responsible attitude.

messages.text: Bene. Con la copertura totale la franchigia è zero.
messages.english: Good. With full coverage the deductible is zero.

choices.text: Ottimo. Cosa succede in caso di guasto alla macchina?
choices.english: Great. What happens in case of a car breakdown?
choices.feedback: Good question about road assistance.

choices.text: Se la macchina si rompe, ne compro una nuova.
choices.english: If the car breaks, I'll buy a new one.
choices.feedback: The rental company has a better solution.

choices.text: In caso di guasto, inizio a piangere.
choices.english: In case of a breakdown, I'll start crying.
choices.feedback: Asking for help is more effective.

messages.text: Abbiamo l'assistenza stradale h24. Basta chiamare questo numero.
messages.english: We have 24/7 road assistance. Just call this number.

choices.text: Perfetto, salvo il numero sul mio telefono.
choices.english: Perfect, I'll save the number on my phone.
choices.feedback: Very practical.

choices.text: Non ho un telefono, uso i segnali di fumo.
choices.english: I don't have a phone, I use smoke signals.
choices.feedback: Not very useful on the highway.

choices.text: Gettiamo il numero dalla finestra.
choices.english: Let's throw the number out the window.
choices.feedback: You will need that number!

messages.text: Ricordi che in Italia la velocità massima in autostrada è 130 km/h.
messages.english: Remember that in Italy the maximum speed on the highway is 130 km/h.

choices.text: Grazie dell'informazione, starò molto attento ai limiti.
choices.english: Thanks for the information, I will be very careful with the limits.
choices.feedback: Safety first.

choices.text: Voglio guidare a trecento all'ora!
choices.english: I want to drive at three hundred an hour!
choices.feedback: That is illegal and dangerous.

choices.text: Le multe sono solo suggerimenti, giusto?
choices.english: Fines are just suggestions, right?
choices.feedback: No, fines must be paid!

messages.text: Esatto. Ecco le chiavi e il contratto da firmare qui.
messages.english: Exactly. Here are the keys and the contract to sign here.

choices.text: Ecco la mia firma. Dove si trova il parcheggio?
choices.english: Here is my signature. Where is the parking lot?
choices.feedback: Ready to pick up the car.

choices.text: Firmo con il sangue, è più solenne.
choices.english: I'll sign with blood, it's more solemn.
choices.feedback: A pen will work just fine.

choices.text: Non firmo niente, voglio andare via subito.
choices.english: I'm not signing anything, I want to leave right away.
choices.feedback: No signature, no car.

messages.text: Il parcheggio è dietro l'edificio. Segua i cartelli gialli.
messages.english: The parking is behind the building. Follow the yellow signs.

choices.text: Va bene, vado subito a controllare l'auto fuori.
choices.english: Okay, I'm going right away to check the car outside.
choices.feedback: Following directions.

choices.text: Non mi piace il giallo, preferisco il blu.
choices.english: I don't like yellow, I prefer blue.
choices.feedback: The signs are yellow, you must follow them.

choices.text: Voglio che mi porti la macchina qui davanti.
choices.english: I want you to bring the car here in front.
choices.feedback: You need to go to the parking lot yourself.

messages.text: Prima di partire, controlli se ci sono graffi o danni.
messages.english: Before leaving, check if there are scratches or damages.

choices.text: Certamente, farò un controllo accurato prima di uscire.
choices.english: Certainly, I will do a thorough check before leaving.
choices.feedback: Very important to avoid future disputes.

choices.text: No, chiudo gli occhi e inizio a guidare.
choices.english: No, I close my eyes and start driving.
choices.feedback: You should definitely look at the car first!

choices.text: Voglio un pennarello per disegnare sulla macchina.
choices.english: I want a marker to draw on the car.
choices.feedback: Don't damage the rental car!

messages.text: Se trova qualcosa di nuovo, me lo dica immediatamente.
messages.english: If you find anything new, tell me immediately.

choices.text: Va bene, la chiamerò subito se vedo un problema.
choices.english: Okay, I'll call you right away if I see a problem.
choices.feedback: Good communication.

choices.text: Preferisco gridare forte nel parcheggio.
choices.english: I prefer to shout loudly in the parking lot.
choices.feedback: Calling the office is more effective.

choices.text: Nasconderò i danni con degli adesivi colorati.
choices.english: I will hide the damages with colored stickers.
choices.feedback: That won't work during the return check.

messages.text: Ha domande su come funziona il freno a mano o il cambio?
messages.english: Do you have questions about how the handbrake or gears work?

choices.text: No, conosco bene questo modello. Grazie mille.
choices.english: No, I know this model well. Thanks a lot.
choices.feedback: Confident with the vehicle.

choices.text: Cos'è un freno? Io voglio solo accelerare.
choices.english: What is a brake? I only want to accelerate.
choices.feedback: Brakes are essential for safety!

choices.text: Voglio un manuale d'uso di mille pagine.
choices.english: I want a thousand-page user manual.
choices.feedback: The basics are usually explained quickly.

messages.text: Perfetto. Le auguro un buon viaggio in Italia. Sia prudente!
messages.english: Perfect. I wish you a good trip in Italy. Be careful!

choices.text: Grazie mille del suo aiuto. Arrivederci!
choices.english: Thanks a lot for your help. Goodbye!
choices.feedback: Friendly departure.

choices.text: Andrò velocissimo per arrivare prima!
choices.english: I will go very fast to arrive sooner!
choices.feedback: Remember the 130 km/h limit!

choices.text: Dove sono le Alpi? Voglio andare a sciare ora.
choices.english: Where are the Alps? I want to go skiing now.
choices.feedback: Check your GPS for the route!

conversations.title: Returning the Car
conversations.description: Drop off the vehicle and finalize the rental.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Riporta la macchina del noleggio?
messages.english: Good morning! Are you returning the rental car?

choices.text: Sì, ho parcheggiato l'auto nel posto numero dieci.
choices.english: Yes, I parked the car in spot number ten.
choices.feedback: Clear information.

choices.text: No, ho perso la macchina in centro.
choices.english: No, I lost the car downtown.
choices.feedback: That's a big problem!

choices.text: La macchina è nel fiume, mi dispiace.
choices.english: The car is in the river, I'm sorry.
choices.feedback: Oh no, hope you have that insurance!

messages.text: Bene. Ha fatto il pieno di benzina prima di tornare?
messages.english: Good. Did you fill up the tank with gas before returning?

choices.text: Sì, il serbatoio è pieno. Ho la ricevuta qui.
choices.english: Yes, the tank is full. I have the receipt here.
choices.feedback: Excellent, avoiding extra charges.

choices.text: No, non c'è più benzina, ho spinto la macchina.
choices.english: No, there's no more gas, I pushed the car.
choices.feedback: You will be charged for the missing fuel.

choices.text: Ho messo del latte nel serbatoio, va bene?
choices.english: I put some milk in the tank, is that okay?
choices.feedback: Definitely not! That will ruin the engine.

messages.text: Ottimo. Controllo subito se ci sono nuovi danni sulla carrozzeria.
messages.english: Great. I'll check right away if there are any new damages on the bodywork.

choices.text: Certamente, la macchina è in perfette condizioni.
choices.english: Certainly, the car is in perfect condition.
choices.feedback: Confidently stating the state of the car.

choices.text: C'è un piccolo graffio, ma è colpa di un gatto.
choices.english: There's a small scratch, but it's a cat's fault.
choices.feedback: You are still responsible for it.

choices.text: Sì, ho tolto le ruote per sicurezza.
choices.english: Yes, I took off the wheels for safety.
choices.feedback: The car needs its wheels!

messages.text: La macchina è a posto. Posso avere le chiavi, per favore?
messages.english: The car is fine. Can I have the keys, please?

choices.text: Ecco le chiavi. È stato un piacere noleggiare da voi.
choices.english: Here are the keys. It was a pleasure renting from you.
choices.feedback: Polite conclusion.

choices.text: Le chiavi sono magiche, non posso darle a nessuno.
choices.english: The keys are magical, I can't give them to anyone.
choices.feedback: They belong to the rental company!

choices.text: Ho mangiato le chiavi, erano croccanti.
choices.english: I ate the keys, they were crunchy.
choices.feedback: That is definitely not healthy.

messages.text: Grazie a lei. Le invieremo la ricevuta finale via email.
messages.english: Thank you. We will send you the final receipt via email.

choices.text: Perfetto. Quanto tempo ci vuole per ricevere l'email?
choices.english: Perfect. How long does it take to receive the email?
choices.feedback: Practical question about the process.

choices.text: Non ho un'email, vivo in una grotta.
choices.english: I don't have an email, I live in a cave.
choices.feedback: They need an email to send the receipt.

choices.text: Voglio una ricevuta scritta su una pietra.
choices.english: I want a receipt written on a stone.
choices.feedback: Digital receipts are much more common now.

messages.text: Arriverà tra pochi minuti. Ha dimenticato qualcosa nell'auto?
messages.english: It will arrive in a few minutes. Did you forget anything in the car?

choices.text: No, ho controllato bene tutto il bagagliaio. Grazie.
choices.english: No, I checked the whole trunk well. Thank you.
choices.feedback: Confirming no personal items left.

choices.text: Sì, ho lasciato il mio elefante sul sedile posteriore.
choices.english: Yes, I left my elephant on the back seat.
choices.feedback: An elephant wouldn't fit in a Fiat 500!

choices.text: Ho dimenticato il mio cuore in questa macchina.
choices.english: I forgot my heart in this car.
choices.feedback: Very poetic, but check for your wallet too.

messages.text: Tutto a posto allora. Com'è andato il suo viaggio in Italia?
messages.english: Everything is in order then. How was your trip in Italy?

choices.text: È stato un viaggio bellissimo, l'auto è stata perfetta.
choices.english: It was a beautiful trip, the car was perfect.
choices.feedback: Positive feedback.

choices.text: Terribile, troppe macchine e troppa gente!
choices.english: Terrible, too many cars and too many people!
choices.feedback: Italian traffic can be intense, but it's part of the experience.

choices.text: Non lo so, ho dormito per tutto il tempo.
choices.english: I don't know, I slept the whole time.
choices.feedback: Hard to enjoy the trip while sleeping!

messages.text: Mi fa piacere. Spero che tornerà presto a trovarci.
messages.english: I'm glad. I hope you will come back to visit us soon.

choices.text: Sicuramente! Mi piace molto l'Italia. A presto.
choices.english: Definitely! I like Italy very much. See you soon.
choices.feedback: Friendly promise to return.

choices.text: No, voglio andare a vivere sulla Luna ora.
choices.english: No, I want to go live on the Moon now.
choices.feedback: That's a bit further away than Italy.

choices.text: Voi siete troppo gentili, mi fate paura.
choices.english: You are too kind, you scare me.
choices.feedback: They are just being professional.

messages.text: Le serve un taxi per andare in aeroporto o in stazione?
messages.english: Do you need a taxi to go to the airport or the station?

choices.text: Sì, un taxi per l'aeroporto sarebbe molto utile. Grazie.
choices.english: Yes, a taxi to the airport would be very useful. Thank you.
choices.feedback: Accepting assistance for onward travel.

choices.text: No, vado a piedi fino a casa mia a Londra.
choices.english: No, I'm walking all the way to my house in London.
choices.feedback: That's a very long walk!

choices.text: Voglio andare all'aeroporto con un cavallo bianco.
choices.english: I want to go to the airport with a white horse.
choices.feedback: Taxis are more common and faster.

messages.text: Chiamo subito un taxi per lei. Arriverà tra due minuti.
messages.english: I'll call a taxi for you right away. It will arrive in two minutes.

choices.text: Molte grazie per tutto. Buona giornata e arrivederci!
choices.english: Many thanks for everything. Have a good day and goodbye!
choices.feedback: Polite final goodbye.

choices.text: Due minuti sono troppi, vado via ora!
choices.english: Two minutes are too many, I'm leaving now!
choices.feedback: Patience is a virtue.

choices.text: Taxi? Cos'è un taxi? Io voglio una nave.
choices.english: Taxi? What is a taxi? I want a ship.
choices.feedback: A taxi will take you to your next stop.
